originality.rationale: Strongest headline exact fact E_-17 rank>=2 is already published in LMFDB. LMFDB 69360.n2 (conductor 69360=2^4*3*5*17^2) records: minimal quadratic twist 15.a2, twist by -68, rank 2, torsion Z/2xZ/2, generators (176,9248),(546,3402). Since -68=-17*2^2, twist by -68 is Q-isomorphic to twist by -17 (twist depends only on squarefree kernel); our E_-17 y^2=x(x+153)(x+12393) is the same Q-class. Hence 'quadratic twist of 15.a2 by -17 has rank>=2' is database-recorded, not new. Same holds for the other four witnesses: d=38 (N~21660),91 (124215),-65,-77 (88935) all have twist conductors <500k (odd-coprime max 15*97^2=141135), therefore inside LMFDB completeness (<500k) with per-curve ranks/generators tabled. The family frequency is mechanically derivable by filtering the 163 j=272223782641/164025 twists by conductor/rank (LMFDB jinv search shows 8 rank-2 twists already). Admission claim that '|d|<=100 largely escapes LMFDB' is false for fallback (15*100^2=150k). Nearest theorems Smith arXiv:1702.02325 (asymptotic Delaunay/o(N) rank>=2) and Bhargava-Skinner (height-ordered rank 1) do not give explicit tables, but LMFDB does give explicit per-twist ranks, which anticipates the lower-bound facts. New generators on a known rank-2 curve and empirical Kummer re-derivation do not establish priority.

value.rationale: Target gap census (closed Sel2 vs rank, gap>=2 frequency, rank>=2 frequency to |d|<=200, root-number agreement) admitted NOT achieved. Achieved fallback is naive-search lower bounds only: 40/122 found points, 82 undecided (rank 0 vs large generator), Selmer UB admitted weak (e.g. d=1 gives 4 not sharp 2), no gap statistic, no root numbers. The 40-count is search-dependent (x=p/q bounds q<=8,|p|<=1500 etc.), not a closed mathematical invariant; incompleteness honestly noted but leaves no exact frequency. Per-twist rank>=1/>=2 lower bounds are exact but already tabled in LMFDB for this conductor range and mechanically implied by LMFDB query, so exact-invariant eligibility clause fails ('value is not known or mechanically implied' not met). Search-minimality for d=-17 is explicitly bounded/honest ('minimal found, large-height generator below 17 not excluded'), not a proven global minimal, and LMFDB already contains the rank-2 fact. No new general theorem, criterion, benchmark, or downstream use beyond re-logging known curve ranks. Certification alone does not rescue an arbitrary search-bound enumeration.
